notes: The italic second why is מַה's distributed realization over the coordinated question (rule 25's interrogative-particle sentence), headed on the first; v.11 writes a second מַה and is aligned separately.

Italic For before the bare appositive יְשׁוּעוֹת is the supplied preposition stating what the nominal contributes and belongs to the noun (rule 33); it is not the verb's valency preposition, since him is the object praise reaches.
